Crude Oil Prices Fluctuate Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Supply Concerns

International crude oil prices are experiencing volatility, influenced by geopolitical events in the Middle East and shifts in global supply dynamics. While some reports indicate falling crude prices internationally, domestic fuel prices remain a point of concern for consumers. Discussions also touch upon US-Iran relations, US oil inventories, and Russia's diesel market decisions, all potentially impacting India's energy landscape.
